notes: «وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is an unnamed co-transmitter; «عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ» is an unnamed gap (rule 8).

«سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» : the Imam is the one asked and answers; the bracketed «[سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ]» is an editor's alternative wording of the same Imam, not a new link. The Imam is written as the report names him (owner ruling 3).
